video_upload.name: Upload (Reels/Shorts/TikTok)
video_upload.desc: Checks a clip against the platform rules, converts it if needed and opens the share menu.
video_upload.help: Pick a video and a platform. The tool checks format (9:16), length, codecs and frame rate. If something does not fit, it creates a 1080x1920 H.264/AAC copy (<name>.<platform>.mp4), trims it to the maximum length if necessary and removes metadata on the way. Then it opens the Android share menu so you can choose the app. Needs ffmpeg; for sharing also the Termux:API app and pkg install termux-api. Clips that need no conversion are shared as they are, so run the privacy stripper first if they contain location data. Platform limits live in plugins/video_upload/platforms.json.

video_upload.high_fps: {fps} fps is more than the platforms accept (max. 60).
